title: System Modernization
description: Migrated a shared Microsoft Teams policy-management NuGet into a standalone service, reducing deployment fragility and enabling safer regional rollouts and operational modernization.

title: Cloud Helper
description: Self-service portal for internal teams to request and provision cloud resources across Azure, AWS, GCP, and internal offerings, paired with workflow automation and operational reporting.

title: PubSub SDK
description: Shared messaging SDK for Teams Management Infrastructure, standardizing contracts for replay, rollback, dead-letter handling, and large-scale backfill scenarios.

title: Test Account Security Compliance Automation
description: Hardened test account systems after a security breach with periodic account expiry, strict authentication requirements, automated onboarding, and the org's first Federated Identity Credential (FIC)-based authentication for test accounts.

title: AI-Assisted Engineering Tooling
description: Built agent-based tooling that parallelizes builds across 12+ projects, automates on-call report assembly via MCP servers, and diffs large policy-change logs with a Longest Common Substring algorithm.
